text:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — planning a Summer All-Hands recognition segment called 'Spotlight Shoutouts'. Want to gather quick peer nominations + 3 mini spot awards. Putting this thread here to coordinate logistics and approvals.

Jamal Ortiz: Love it. What are the deadlines? and budget for the 3 mini spot awards? :sparkles:

Maya Patel: Target deadline = next Friday EOD. Budget is $150 per mini award (gift card + swag). Need final sign-off from People Ops + Finance.

Sophia Chen: Are nominations anonymous? do we allow managers to nominate their direct reports?

Maya Patel: Prefer non-anonymous by default but we can accept anonymous. Managers can nominate, just note relationship in the form. We want context (1-2 bullets) explaining impact.

HR-Bot: Nomination form created: https://forms.gle/exampleSummerShoutouts

Leo Park: I can help triage nominations and format winners slide for All-Hands. Can you drop the exact fields for the form here, Maya?

Maya Patel: Sure — form fields (keeping short):
```
- Nominee name
- Nominator name (optional)
- Team
- Reason (2 bullets, what impact?)
- Example jira/PR or link (optional)
- Prefer anonymous? (yes/no)
- Award preference (swag/gift card/charity)
```

Ava Gomez: Do we need to loop in Finance for the payouts now or after winners picked? I can ping them when we have finalists.

Jamal Ortiz: Finance prefers the list + amount before payout. I'll reach out to Priya in finance today and cc People Ops when we have 3 finalists.

Sophia Chen: Suggest we add a quick rubric for selection — impact on customer, cross-team help, shipping under pressure. Keeps it fair.

Maya Patel: Good call. Short rubric: customer impact, collaboration, velocity. Each rated 1-3 by reviewers. I'll add to the form description.

HR-Bot: Reminder scheduled: "Last call for Spotlight Shoutouts" will post in #general 1 day before deadline.

Leo Park: Also, can we allow managers to nominate multiple people? sometimes teams have more than one standout.

Maya Patel: Yes — unlimited nominations, but each nomination requires a separate submission.

Ava Gomez: I'll create a shared spreadsheet to collect final winners and payment details. Sharing link when ready.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — action items:
- Maya: update form with rubric + deadline (today)
- HR-Bot: post reminders (1d before, morning of deadline)
- Leo: format winners slide (after finalists)
- Jamal: ping Finance with finalists list
- Ava: prepare payout spreadsheet

Maya Patel: Please @mention me in the form responses if you flag any nomination you think needs manager approval. :thumbsup:

Jamal Ortiz: On it. Anything else? otherwise I'll ping Finance and set calendar block to review finalists next Monday.

Sophia Chen: Can we add a non-monetary 'shoutout' line in the All-Hands script so folks get the spotlight if they opt out of gift card? small recognition matters.

Maya Patel: Done — adding a "shoutout only" option. OK closing thread for now, will post updates as they come in. Thanks! :tada:
